sourceFile: 49.BRS-161014  REPORT TEST  MG 161014-S-A, MG 161014-S-B, MG 161014-C OF CHINA EAST SUPPLIER_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source context but misgroups the changed factor and includes many invalid extracted measurements.
issues: Baseline is explicit as NORMAL, not unknown.
Primary factor should be new China East MG test material versus normal MG.
MG-S-A, MG-S-B, and MG-C should be subgroup conditions.
Many header or summary rows are misparsed as numeric measurements.
Final SPK out-of-spec NG result is not properly captured.
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as TEST new China East MG versus NORMAL MG.
Preserve MG-S-A, MG-S-B, MG-C as subgroups.
Remove header-derived and duplicate measurement outcomes.
Rebuild outcomes for bond spread, NG process, tension, drop, semi-yoke Gauss, and final SPK Gauss.
Set judgements from result and decision rows, including final SPK NG/out-of-spec.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but many are headers only; final evidence needs data plus result/decision rows.
